zh:
Alacritty - 快速、跨平台的 OpenGL 终端模拟器

## 简介 Alacritty 是一个现代终端模拟器，具有合理的默认设置，同时允许广泛的[配置](#配置)。它通过与其他应用集成，而不是重新实现其功能，提供灵活的[功能](https://github.com/alacritty/alacritty/blob/aecf0f600fa840a415b55da5cf34fbeaec39ac32/docs/features.md)并保持高性能。目前支持的平台包括 BSD、Linux、macOS 和 Windows。 该软件被认为处于 **beta** 阶段；仍有部分功能缺失和错误需要修复，但许多人已经将它作为日常工具使用。 预编译二进制文件可从 [GitHub 发行页面](https://github.com/alacritty/alacritty/releases)获取。 如果你有问题或需要快速帮助，可以加入 libera.chat 上的 [`#alacritty`]。 [`#alacritty`]: https://web.libera.chat/gamja/?channels=#alacritty ## 功能 可在[此处](https://github.com/alacritty/alacritty/blob/aecf0f600fa840a415b55da5cf34fbeaec39ac32/docs/features.md)查看 Alacritty 的功能概览。 ## 更多信息 - [Announcing Alacritty, a GPU-Accelerated Terminal Emulator](https://jwilm.io/blog/announcing-alacritty/) 2017 年 1 月 6 日 - [A talk about Alacritty at the Rust Meetup January 2017](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qHOdYO3WUTk) 2017 年 1 月 19 日 - [Alacritty Lands Scrollback, Publishes Benchmarks](https://jwilm.io/blog/alacritty-lands-scrollback/) 2018 年 9 月 17 日 ## 安装 Alacritty 可以通过 Linux、BSD、macOS 和 Windows 上的多种包管理器安装。 macOS 和 Windows 的预构建二进制文件也可从 [GitHub 发行页面](https://github.com/alacritty/alacritty/releases)下载。 其他用户可以在[此处](https://github.com/alacritty/alacritty/blob/aecf0f600fa840a415b55da5cf34fbeaec39ac32/INSTALL.md)查看详细的 Alacritty 安装说明。 ### 系统要求 - 至少需要 OpenGL ES 2.0 - [Windows] 支持 ConPTY（Windows 10 版本 1809 或更高版本） ## 配置 可通过 `man 5 alacritty` 查看 Alacritty 配置文档；如果没有安装 man 页面，也可以查看[网站][the website]。 [the website]: https://alacritty.org/config-alacritty.html Alacritty 不会自动创建配置文件，但会在以下位置查找： 1. `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/alacritty/alacritty.toml` 2. `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/alacritty.toml` 3. `$HOME/.config/alacritty/alacritty.toml` 4. `$HOME/.alacritty.toml` 5. `/etc/alacritty/alacritty.toml` 在 Windows 上，会在以下位置查找配置文件： * `%APPDATA%\alacritty\alacritty.toml` ## 参与贡献 Alacritty 的贡献指南位于 [`CONTRIBUTING.md`](https://github.com/alacritty/alacritty/blob/aecf0f600fa840a415b55da5cf34fbeaec39ac32/CONTRIBUTING.md) 文件中。 ## FAQ **_它真的是最快的终端模拟器吗？_** 终端模拟器的基准测试很复杂。Alacritty 使用 [vtebench](https://github.com/alacritty/vtebench) 量化终端模拟器的吞吐量，并在该测试中持续取得优于其他产品的成绩。如果你发现并非如此的例子，请报告问题。 延迟、帧率和帧一致性等其他方面更难量化。有些终端模拟器也会有意减速以节省资源，这可能是部分用户更喜欢的方式。 如果你对 Alacritty 的性能或易用性有疑问，衡量终端模拟器的最佳方法始终是使用**你自己的**具体场景进行测试。 **_为什么没有实现某个功能？_** Alacritty 有许多功能，但并不包含其他每个终端中的所有功能。原因可能有很多，有时只是某个功能不适合 Alacritty。因此，你不会在其中找到标签页或分屏（这些最好交给窗口管理器或[终端复用器][tmux]），也不会找到图形界面配置编辑器等便利功能。 [tmux]: https://github.com/tmux/tmux ## 许可证 Alacritty 按照 [Apache License, Version 2.0] 发布。 [Apache License, Version 2.0]: https://github.com/alacritty/alacritty/blob/aecf0f600fa840a415b55da5cf34fbeaec39ac32/LICENSE-APACHE
en:
Alacritty - A fast, cross-platform, OpenGL terminal emulator

## About Alacritty is a modern terminal emulator that comes with sensible defaults, but allows for extensive [configuration](#configuration). By integrating with other applications, rather than reimplementing their functionality, it manages to provide a flexible set of [features](https://github.com/alacritty/alacritty/blob/aecf0f600fa840a415b55da5cf34fbeaec39ac32/docs/features.md) with high performance. The supported platforms currently consist of BSD, Linux, macOS and Windows. The software is considered to be at a **beta** level of readiness; there are a few missing features and bugs to be fixed, but it is already used by many as a daily driver. Precompiled binaries are available from the [GitHub releases page](https://github.com/alacritty/alacritty/releases). Join [`#alacritty`] on libera.chat if you have questions or looking for a quick help. [`#alacritty`]: https://web.libera.chat/gamja/?channels=#alacritty ## Features You can find an overview over the features available in Alacritty [here](https://github.com/alacritty/alacritty/blob/aecf0f600fa840a415b55da5cf34fbeaec39ac32/docs/features.md). ## Further information - [Announcing Alacritty, a GPU-Accelerated Terminal Emulator](https://jwilm.io/blog/announcing-alacritty/) January 6, 2017 - [A talk about Alacritty at the Rust Meetup January 2017](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qHOdYO3WUTk) January 19, 2017 - [Alacritty Lands Scrollback, Publishes Benchmarks](https://jwilm.io/blog/alacritty-lands-scrollback/) September 17, 2018 ## Installation Alacritty can be installed by using various package managers on Linux, BSD, macOS and Windows. Prebuilt binaries for macOS and Windows can also be downloaded from the [GitHub releases page](https://github.com/alacritty/alacritty/releases). For everyone else, the detailed instructions to install Alacritty can be found [here](https://github.com/alacritty/alacritty/blob/aecf0f600fa840a415b55da5cf34fbeaec39ac32/INSTALL.md). ### Requirements - At least OpenGL ES 2.0 - [Windows] ConPTY support (Windows 10 version 1809 or higher) ## Configuration You can find the documentation for Alacritty's configuration in `man 5 alacritty`, or by looking at [the website] if you do not have the manpages installed. [the website]: https://alacritty.org/config-alacritty.html Alacritty doesn't create the config file for you, but it looks for one in the following locations: 1. `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/alacritty/alacritty.toml` 2. `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/alacritty.toml` 3. `$HOME/.config/alacritty/alacritty.toml` 4. `$HOME/.alacritty.toml` 5. `/etc/alacritty/alacritty.toml` On Windows, the config file will be looked for in: * `%APPDATA%\alacritty\alacritty.toml` ## Contributing A guideline about contributing to Alacritty can be found in the [`CONTRIBUTING.md`](https://github.com/alacritty/alacritty/blob/aecf0f600fa840a415b55da5cf34fbeaec39ac32/CONTRIBUTING.md) file. ## FAQ **_Is it really the fastest terminal emulator?_** Benchmarking terminal emulators is complicated. Alacritty uses [vtebench](https://github.com/alacritty/vtebench) to quantify terminal emulator throughput and manages to consistently score better than the competition using it. If you have found an example where this is not the case, please report a bug. Other aspects like latency or framerate and frame consistency are more difficult to quantify. Some terminal emulators also intentionally slow down to save resources, which might be preferred by some users. If you have doubts about Alacritty's performance or usability, the best way to quantify terminal emulators is always to test them with **your** specific usecases. **_Why isn't feature X implemented?_** Alacritty has many great features, but not every feature from every other terminal. This could be for a number of reasons, but sometimes it's just not a good fit for Alacritty. This means you won't find things like tabs or splits (which are best left to a window manager or [terminal multiplexer][tmux]) nor niceties like a GUI config editor. [tmux]: https://github.com/tmux/tmux ## License Alacritty is released under the [Apache License, Version 2.0]. [Apache License, Version 2.0]: https://github.com/alacritty/alacritty/blob/aecf0f600fa840a415b55da5cf34fbeaec39ac32/LICENSE-APACHE
